reference.question: 查询2025年每股净资产超过股价的股票（破净股）
reference.query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.total_assets * 10000 / s.total_shares) AS bps, s.current_price FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' AND (f.total_assets * 10000 / s.total_shares) > s.current_price;

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 查询优先股股票中，每股净资产最高的前两名

steps.query: SELECT s.stock_name, (f.total_assets * 10000 / s.total_shares) AS bps FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id WHERE s.share_right_type = 'PREFERRED' AND f.report_date = '2025-12-31' ORDER BY bps DESC LIMIT 2;

examples_in_actual_prompt.question: 计算各行业2025年平均每股净资产

steps.query: SELECT i.industry_name, AVG((f.total_assets * 10000) / s.total_shares) FROM finance_tax.stocks s JOIN finance_tax.companies c ON s.company_id = c.company_id JOIN finance_tax.company_financials f ON s.company_id = f.company_id JOIN common.dict_industry i ON c.industry_code = i.industry_code WHERE f.report_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.industry_name;

knowledge_in_actual_prompt.knowledge_text: 市盈率(PE)近似指股价与每股净利润的比值，其中每股净利润等于净利润除以总股本，净利润近似为总资产减总负债，总资产需由万元转换为元。计算公式：current_price / ((total_assets - total_liabilities) * 10000 / total_shares)。
每股收益(EPS)近似指净利润与总股本的比值，其中净利润近似为总资产减总负债，总资产需由万元转换为元。计算公式：(total_assets - total_liabilities) * 10000 / total_shares。
